principles: Separate game rules, world extraction, derived world analysis, planning strategy, and playthrough state.
Treat the default resource map as one world configuration, not immutable geometry.
Use extracted resource actor id as stable socket_id and save join key.
Keep raw build-pinned extraction artifacts immutable; canonical tables are projections.
Derived analysis must be regenerable from canonical world/game inputs.
Rocky Desert is a validation/reference plan, not the definition of world-analysis logic.

layers.world: build-pinned world extraction and materialized world configurations
layers.planning: planner semantics, plans, strategies and mutable run state

world_contract.join_policy: socket_id equals extracted world actor id; save instanceName is Persistent_Level:PersistentLevel.<socket_id>

client_boundary: UI/mod clients consume normalized contracts; planner logic stays outside clients.
